name: auto-compact
description: Starts a new session with a handoff summary when the context passes 250K tokens at a natural break, or 500K tokens at any point.

threshold.title: Soft limit (tokens)
threshold.description: From this size, start a new session at the next natural break in the work.

max.title: Hard limit (tokens)
max.description: At this size, start a new session after the turn, mid-task or not.
